text:
emma: Quick heads-up — release v3.12 cutoff in ~11h. Can folks confirm console docs, SDK regen, and changelog status? We need a version bump and a final changelog tidy before cutoff.

javier: Docs site PRs are queued. One doc image CDN cache issue is blocking the build for /console/auth. Trying a cache-bust now.

sasha: Started SDK docs regen on the release branch but the TypeScript examples test fails in ci. Error shows new enum value not recognized. Pinging @micah for API change alignment.

micah: Saw that. API added `route_priority` enum; SDK needs the new mapping. I can push a tiny compatibility shim to release/v3.12 in ~15m.

javier: If that lands I can re-run the docsite build. Also need someone to approve #789 (changelog bump) — it's a one-line entry under Unreleased.

olivia: Quick note — please keep changelog entries under the "Unreleased" header and use the `console:` prefix for console-related items. I nudged #789 with a suggested wording.

emma: Suggested changelog text for the entry: ```
- console: add support for route priority in backend routing (user-facing: routing behavior unchanged) (PR #456)
```

sasha: thanks — I updated the SDK regen job to skip strict type failure for examples temporarily so docs can build, but we'll revert after the shim. CI job: `./ci/regenerate-sdk-docs --branch release/v3.12`

deploy-bot: ci/build #432 passed — docs-site:staging build succeeded (link: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/432) :white_check_mark:

javier: CI green. PR #789 approved by @olivia. I'm triggering docsite deploy to staging now: `scripts/deploy-docs.sh staging release/v3.12`

micah: Shim is merged and pushed (force-push). sasha, can you re-run the SDK regen now?

sasha: Kicking it now. ETA ~6m. Will post results.

emma: Plan summary: micah merges compatibility shim, sasha finishes SDK regen and tests, javier triggers docs deploy, olivia finalizes changelog meta. If any of this is blocked by +6h escalate to @emma and we’ll do a manual rollback plan. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: docs deploy to staging kicked (job #847).

javier: Staging docs site looks good on my end, images rendering OK after cache-bust. Let me know if you spot anything.

sasha: SDK regen succeeded and publish artifacts uploaded to staging storage. Tests pass locally and in CI.

emma: Awesome — leaving this thread open for any last-minute bumps. If nothing else by +10h we'll cut the release branch. Thanks all! :rocket:
